title: Vacation Rental Manager
description:
We are looking for a reliable and highly responsive Short Term Rental Manager for a long time role helping us to manage our short-term rental properties. You will be the backbone of our daily operations—handling guest communication, coordinating ground teams, and ensuring our properties run smoothly.



Because hospitality is a 24/7 industry, this role requires you to monitor our accounts 7 days a week during US hours. You must be available to see messages as they come in and respond quickly and appropriately.



Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication: Monitor accounts continuously (7 days a week) and respond promptly to all guest inquiries, booking requests, and issues.



Maintenance Coordination: While our software automatically schedules our cleaners for turnovers, there are times where we need to coordinate with local service providers (handymen, plumbers, etc.) to complete any necessary repairs and we would want you to manage this process to ensure it is completed as quickly as possible.



Supply Management:  Coordinate with Cleaning teams to Track property inventory and purchase daily supplies (toilet paper, coffee, cleaning products) online to be delivered to properties.



Daily Promotion: Actively promote our rental listings daily across social media and booking forums to drive occupancy.



Requirements

Availability: Must be available to work and monitor accounts 7 days a week during US business hours.



Excellent English: Flawless written English with a polite, hospitable, and professional tone.



Responsiveness: Ability to reply to guest messages and dispatch repair teams quickly.



Tech-Savvy & Reliable: Must have a fast, stable internet connection, backup power/internet, and comfort using booking platforms (Airbnb/VRBO) and messaging apps.



Experience: Prior experience in short-term rental management or customer service is highly preferred.



How to Apply

Please send your resume and a short message outlining your experience with short-term rentals. In your message, please include the phrase "7-Day STR Manager" at the top so we know you understand the schedule requirements!

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Client Success & Onboarding Specialist to be the welcoming face and supportive backbone for our clients. Technology & Transaction Coordination (TC) Support

-Tech Support: Assist clients with initial platform setups, software integrations, and troubleshooting basic technical hurdles.

-TC Assistance: Provide additional administrative support related to transaction coordination, data management, and keeping systems updated.



Qualifications & Skills

-Experience: 1–3 years in a Client Success, Account Management, Customer Onboarding, or Virtual Assistant role.

- Tech-Savvy: Quick to learn new software, CRM systems, transaction management tools, and template builders (e.g., Canva, HubSpot, or industry-specific tech).

-Organization: Ultra-organized with a knack for meticulous note-taking and project tracking.

- Problem-Solving: A "find a way" attitude when clients encounter technical or procedural friction.

The chance to contribute to the success and expansion of a forward-thinking company.

title: Creative Quality Manager
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a highly perceptive, creatively sharp Creative Quality Manager to help strengthen the quality, consistency, and scalability of our photo and video delivery pipeline. This person will serve as a high-level internal creative checkpoint — reviewing deliverables, identifying recurring quality issues, spotting patterns across shooters and editors, and helping our team improve creative consistency without adding more burden to already-stretched internal leaders. This is not a basic admin or upload role. We are looking for someone with a strong creative eye first, especially in video, who can also think operationally, document issues clearly, and help improve backend workflows over time.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Review video deliverables before final delivery to ensure quality and consistency

- Catch technical and creative misses before they reach the client

- Identify patterns across shooters and editors, including recurring strengths, misses, and coaching opportunities

- Flag issues related to coverage, pacing, framing, shot variety, detail shots, creative direction, music choice, captions, and overall polish

- Organize observations and feedback clearly for internal leadership

- Help create stronger quality control standards and backend review processes

- Support delivery readiness by ensuring projects are complete, clean, and aligned with internal expectations

- Help reduce the amount of proofing, review, and repetitive delivery work sitting on senior internal tea
mbers

- Contribute to SOPs, workflow improvements, and quality documentation as the team grows

- Writing feedback briefs to photographers and videographers regarding review and delivery

- Ensuring brand standards for photos and videos (correct logos, fonts, colors, etc.)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Fewer quality issues slipping through to clients

- Better visibility into shooter/editor performance trends

- Stronger internal feedback loops for creative coaching

- More consistency across delivered video content

- Less manual review burden on the internal team

- Cleaner backend systems and a more scalable delivery process



IDEAL BACKGROUND

- Strong video editing or post-production background

- Excellent creative judgment and attention to detail

- Ability to spot both technical and aesthetic issues quickly

- Experience reviewing work for quality, not just producing it

- Organized, process-aware, and able to document findings clearly

- Real estate media experience

- Comfortable working behind the scenes in a support and oversight capacity

- Strong AI skillsets such as Higgsfield, Nano Banana Pro, Eleven Labs, Claude, and others



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume creative environment

- Familiarity with distributed editing teams or offshore creative support

- Operational or workflow improvement experience

title: Supply Chain & Production Planning Analyst
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized and analytical Supply Chain & Production Planning Analyst to support the end-to-end management of our global supply chain across multiple consumer brands, products, and international manufacturing partners. This role is responsible for coordinating production planning, monitoring inventory levels, managing purchase orders, and ensuring products move efficiently from factory to warehouse.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, confident working with data, and experienced in communicating with factories, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams to maintain accurate inventory and production timelines.



Key Responsibilities



Production Planning & Inventory Management



* Maintain production plans based on sales trends, forecasts, inventory levels, and lead times.

* Monitor inventory across multiple brands and warehouses to ensure optimal stock levels.

* Analyze sales performance and inventory data to recommend production and replenishment plans.

* Identify potential inventory shortages or excess inventory and recommend corrective actions.

* Prepare and distribute weekly inventory reports, including:



  * Inventory updates

  * New Item Tracker

  * Other inventory reporting as required



Purchase Order & Logistics Coordination



* Create and maintain purchase orders within QuickBooks.

* Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders to ensure timely movement of goods.

* Monitor shipment schedules from factory through final warehouse delivery.

* Track containers in transit and provide regular status updates.

* Communicate landed cost changes to relevant internal teams.



Import & Customs Coordination



* Review and maintain accurate HTS classifications for imported products.

* Research tariff updates and assess their impact on product costs.

* Prepare reports for containers arriving at ports and communicate expected arrivals.



Inventory Receiving & System Maintenance



* Transfer inventory within QuickBooks from "In Transit/On the Water" to warehouse inventory upon receipt.

* Coordinate with warehouse teams to verify container receipts against purchase orders.

* Investigate and resolve discrepancies between received inventory and purchase orders.



Reporting & Documentation



* Provide inventory reporting to internal sales operations teams for customer portal uploads.

* Maintain organized records of shipping documents, customs documentation, invoices, and supporting files.

* Save and distribute supporting documentation to the Accounting department for payment processing and reconciliation.

* Prepare operational reports to support management decision-making.



Qualifications



* Experience in supply chain, production planning, purchasing, or international logistics.

* Experience working with overseas manufacturers and international shipping.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and inventory data.

* Experience with QuickBooks, Claude, and Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, reporting).

* Understanding of international shipping, customs processes, HTS codes, tariffs, and landed cost calculations.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

title: Real Estate Video Editor
description:
Role Overview: Full Time Position | $4.50/hr room for negotiation | 9am-5pm EST



We are looking for a world class Video Editor to lead the post-production for our rapidly growing real estate YouTube channel. You won’t just be cutting clips; you will be responsible for crafting 10-20 minute "Masterclass" style relocation guides, home tours, and market updates designed to turn viewers into leads.



You must be an expert in retention based editing, knowing exactly when to use B-roll, zoom cuts, and sound effects to keep a viewer engaged for 15+ minutes. You will also be responsible for "mining" our long form content to create high impact, viral style Shorts/Reels.



Key Responsibilities

1. Long Form Mastery: Edit 3 high quality long form videos (10–20 mins) per week. This includes color grading, audio leveling (cleaning up "wind" or "echo" from field recordings), and advanced storytelling.

2. Short Form Distribution: Extract and edit a minimum of 5 engaging Shorts/TikToks per week. These must feature "Alex Hormozi style" captions, dynamic zooms, and high energy pacing.

3. Engagement First Editing: Implement "Pattern Interrupts" (B-roll, text overlays, sound design) every 5–10 seconds to maintain high Average View Duration (AVD).

4. Green Screen Integration: Seamlessly integrate Will's talking head footage with property B-roll, Google Earth maps, and market data graphics.

5. Asset Management: Sourcing high quality stock footage, music, and sound effects that match our "Authentic, grounded, yet premium" brand voice.



Technical Requirements

1. Software: Expert level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Experience with After Effects for custom motion graphics is a major plus.

2. Short Form Tools: Mastery of CapCut or similar for fast paced social media editing.

3. AI Integration: Familiarity with AI tools (Descript/Opus Pro/RunwayML) to maximize efficiency.

4. Real Estate Intuition: Ability to distinguish between "boring house footage" and "lifestyle B-roll" that sells the neighborhood, not just the kitchen.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your success in this role will be measured by:

1. Average View Duration (AVD): Can you keep people watching past the 50% mark?

2. Click Through Rate (CTR) Collaboration: Working with our Digital Marketing Director to ensure the "hook" of the video matches the promise of the thumbnail.

3. Inbound Leads: Quality editing that builds trust and prompts viewers to click the "Contact Us" links.



Who You Are

1. You are a Storyteller first and an editor second.

2. You are obsessed with YouTube analytics and understand why a viewer clicks away.

3. You don't need "step by step" instructions; you can take a raw 30 minute Will rant and find the "Gold" that belongs in the final cut.

4. You are organized and can handle a high volume workflow (8 total deliverables per week).

title: Senior Operations Support Coordinator — High-Ownership Role (Remote, PST Hours, Long-Term)
description:
Senior Operations Support Coordinator - High-Ownership Role (Remote, PST Hours, Long-Term)



American Standard Adhesives, Inc.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST

About the Company



American Standard Adhesives, Inc. (ASA) is a U.S.-based manufacturer and distributor of industrial adhesive products, serving a diverse base of customers across multiple industries. Our lean team plays a critical role in keeping our day-to-day operations running smoothly and our customers well-served.



1. Position Summary



This is not an entry-level VA role. We are hiring a senior operator who can own recurring workflow, coordinate across teams, and escalate well. If you are looking for light remote work or a side gig, please do not apply.



The Operations Support Coordinator is a senior supportive role that helps the Owner run the day-to-day operational workflow of American Standard Adhesives. This person owns the repetitive, structured, and recurring tasks across the operation, and serves as a coordination point between back office, warehouse, accounting, and sales support functions.



This is a support role, not a decision-making role. The Owner retains all final decision-making authority over pricing, commitments, disputes, personnel, and policy. The Operations Support Coordinator is empowered to execute within established SOPs and Work Instructions, to coordinate across teams, and to escalate exceptions promptly.



The Operations Support Coordinator works side-by-side with the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist, who manages the day-to-day order workflow. This role requires a working understanding of the order processing function so that coverage, overflow, and escalation handling are seamless.



2. Key Responsibilities



A. Order & Back Office Coordination — ~30%



Support the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist with order flow, including purchase order handling, invoicing, and customer acknowledgments.



Monitor the open order queue daily; flag bottlenecks and aging orders to the Owner.



Coordinate between back office and warehouse on daily outbound orders.



Maintain visibility across online and third-party platforms, as well as direct customer order channels.



Provide coverage for the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist during absences or peak volume.



B. Shipping & Warehouse Coordination — ~20%



Coordinate shipping label creation and communicate with the warehouse on daily picking and shipping.



Coordinate parcel and pallet shipments across all channels.



Liaise with the warehouse team on picking and shipping.



Ensure shipping documentation is accurate and filed.



Confirm end-of-day shipment closure with the warehouse through direct communication.



C. Import & Vendor Coordination — ~15%



Support recurring import workflows, including container tracking and customs follow-up.



Manage the vendor
 channel: monitoring, routing, and filing per company work instructions.



Maintain vendor files and supporting documentation.



Draft vendor communications for Owner review when commitments are involved.



D. Compliance, Insurance & Risk — ~10%



Coordinate contractor file tracking, insurance certificate collection, and renewal calendars.



Support tenant verification and related compliance workflows where applicable.



Keep compliance records organized per company file-naming guidelines.



E. Recurring Administrative & Systems Tasks — ~15%



File and folder organization across company systems, per internal guidelines.



Accounting system data entry support (bookkeeping execution only — not financial decisions).



Pull and format operational and margin reports for Owner review.



Maintain quality assurance and product documentation.



Support system administration tasks under Owner direction.



F. Project-Based & Ad Hoc Support — ~10%



Support insurance renewals, hiring and recruitment coordination, and SOP documentation.



Prepare case or claim files for Owner review.



Handle time-sensitive special tasks requiring independent follow-up within pre-approved scope.



3. Authority & Decision Boundaries



This is an execution and coordination role, not a decision-making role. Clarity here protects the business and the person in the role.



The Operations Support Coordinator MAY:



Execute any task covered by an existing Work Instruction or SOP.



Coordinate teammates, vendors, and carriers within pre-approved scope.



Draft communications, quotations, and documents for Owner review.



Flag exceptions, risks, and decision points upward promptly and in writing.



Provide data, summaries, and recommendations to help the Owner d
 faster.



The Operations Support Coordinator MAY NOT (without Owner approval):



Approve pricing, discounts, credit terms, or payment terms.



Commit the company to vendor contracts, service agreements, or long-term arrangements.



Approve refunds, returns outside written policy, or customer concessions.



Approve hiring, terminations, promotions, or compensation changes.



Change SOPs, policies, or approve new processes without written Owner sign-off.



Resolve disputes involving material money, legal exposure, or customer retention.



When in doubt, escalate. Speed and clarity of escalation is valued over independent judgment on gray-area items.



4. Qualifications



Required



Minimum 3 years of full-time professional experience in a corporate or BPO environment (operations, logistics, customer service, or back office support). 5+ years strongly preferred. Freelance, VA marketplace, or solo remote work alone does not qualify.



Working knowledge of general accounting software, shipping software, Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Excel), and business phone systems.



Strong English communication — written and spoken — with a clear, concise, professional tone.



Proven ability to follow SOPs and Work Instructions precisely.



Excellent organization; able to work within existing file naming and folder structures without disturbing them.



Disciplined on escalation: knows what to d
, what to ask, and what to document.



Ability to handle a mix of repetitive and non-repetitive tasks with minimal supervision.



Preferred



Import/export or logistics coordination exposure.



Industrial supply, distribution, or manufacturing background.



Experience supporting an owner-operated small or mid-size business.



Analytical or accounting background.



5. What We’re Looking For



Highly organized with strong attention to detail.



Proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than letting them escalate.



Reliable, self-managed, and comfortable in a fast-paced, lean team environment.



Comfortable managing multiple priorities and shifting tasks throughout the day.



Mature judgment — knows when to act, when to ask, and when to escalate.



Operates well under clear boundaries and is comfortable supporting, not leading.



6. Success Metrics (First 90 Days)



Zero preventable shipping errors.



Vendor
 inbox processed daily with no unrouted items older than 24 hours.



Daily visibility of order queue status reported to the Owner.



Backup coverage established for the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist on core order workflow tasks.



All escalations documented with context and a recommended next step.



7. Reporting & Working Relationships



Reports directly to the Owner.



Works daily alongside the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist.



Coordinates with the warehouse team, accounting, and service / vendor contacts.



Escalates customer or partner-facing decisions to the Owner.



8. Schedule Requirements



Full-time, Monday–Friday.



Fixed PST schedule: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.



No flexi-time or alternative schedules.



Must be fully available during PST business hours.



9. Compensation



Competitive rate based on experience.

Minimum Hourly Rate: $7 USD/hour (starting rate)

Long-term, stable engagement with room to grow.



10. Required from applicants:



Resume

ID Proof verified

Video intro (required, not optional)

Full-time availability confirmed

PST schedule confirmed (8–4 PST or 9–5 PST)

Our primary focus is serving law firms nationwide, helping them create exceptional first impressions and convert more qualified prospects into clients.



While much of the industry continues to move toward automation, AI, and chatbots, our philosophy remains simple:

Butts in Seats. Not Bots in the Cloud.



We believe that when someone is searching for legal help, they deserve to interact with a real person. Every conversation we handle is powered by a trained human tea
mber—not artificial intelligence. Our commitment to genuine human interaction is what sets us apart and has fueled our growth for more than a decade.



As we continue to expand, we're building a world-class remote workforce capable of delivering exceptional service at scale. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about developing people, improving performance, and creating systems that help employees succeed.



If you're excited about building high-performing remote teams, developing talent, and creating measurable business impact through training and coaching, we'd love to meet you.



Overview

We are seeking a Training Manager to own the onboarding, development, certification, and ongoing education of our remote chat agent workforce. This role is responsible for ensuring every new hire receives a consistent, high-quality training experience and is fully prepared to succeed in production.



The Training Manager will design and deliver training programs, oversee agent readiness, partner with Operations and Quality teams to address performance gaps, and continuously improve learning initiatives that drive quality, efficiency, and client outcomes. This position is accountable not only for training delivery, but for the measurable success of agents after training.



The ideal candidate has experience building and managing remote training programs, coaching adult learners, developing curriculum, and creating scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth.



 Key Responsibilities: 



New Hire Training & Onboarding

  * Own the end-to-end onboarding and training experience for all new chat agents.

  * Design and deliver structured onboarding programs that prepare agents for legal intake and live chat responsibilities.

  * Ensure all new hires complete training, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * Conduct readiness assessments and certify agents before transition to production teams.

  * Facilitate seamless handoffs between Training, Operations, and Quality teams.



Training Program Development

  * Design, implement, and continuously improve training programs for new and existing agents.

  * Develop lesson plans, training materials, SOPs, assessments, simulations, certifications, and knowledge base content.

  * Ensure training content remains current, accurate, and aligned with operational processes and client requirements.

  * Create scalable training systems capable of supporting company growth and new client launches.

  * Incorporate adult learning principles and instructional design best practices into all training initiatives.

title: Accounting Automation Engineer
description:
*TO APPLY CLICK HERE: 



Spotter Labs is hiring Accounting Automation Engineers to help automate manual processes across accounting, finance, and related business systems.



This role is for someone who can understand how work is being done today, identify repetitive manual steps, connect data across systems, build automation, and create cleaner workflows that are accurate, repeatable, and scalable.



The initial focus will be Accounting and Finance, but strong performers may also support automation projects in other departments as the company continues to grow.



*What You Will Do

Review manual accounting and finance workflows and identify opportunities for automation.

Build repeatable processes across multiple systems, exports, reports, and data sources.

Improve reconciliations, journal-entry preparation, close tracking, reporting, and exception management.

Help connect operational data to accounting and finance processes.

Create templates, scripts, dashboards, workflows, and documentation that reduce manual work.

Work with accounting, finance, operations, and technology teams to understand process gaps and build practical solutions.

Design controls so automation improves accuracy rather than simply speeding up bad processes.

Create exception-based workflows so teams can focus on issues instead of routine data entry.

Document processes clearly so they can be maintained and improved over time.



*What We Are Looking For

We are looking for practical automation builders who can work across business systems and messy real-world data.



*The ideal candidate has:

Experience automating manual processes using tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python, Power Query, VBA, Google Apps Script, Zapier, Make, Power Automate, APIs, or similar platforms.

Strong ability to work with data exports, reports, spreadsheets, and system-generated files.

Understanding of accounting or finance processes, including reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close, AP, payroll, reporting, or financial analysis.

Ability to map a current process, identify failure points, and build a cleaner workflow.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Ability to work with non-technical users and translate business problems into automated solutions.

Good documentation habits.

Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where systems and processes are still being built.



*Preferred Experience

Experience working with accounting, ERP, banking, payroll, expense management, inventory, reporting, or operational systems.

Experience building dashboards, exception reports, reconciliation tools, or workflow automations.

Experience with multi-system data matching and process improvement.

Experience supporting accounting, finance, operations, logistics, transportation, or other data-heavy business environments.

Accounting, finance, data analytics, systems, or engineering background preferred.



*The Type of Person Who Will Succeed

This role is best for someone who likes solving practical business problems.

You should be able to look at a manual process and ask:



*Why is this being done manually?

What data is needed?

Where does the data come from?

What can be automated safely?

What should remain subject to review?

How do we prove the output is accurate?

How do we make the process repeatable?



We do not need someone who only writes code in isolation. We need someone who can understand the business process, work with the people doing the work, and build useful automation that holds up in the real world.



*Hiring Process

Candidates may be asked to complete a practical work sample involving process mapping, data cleanup, reconciliation logic, automation design, reporting, or workflow improvement.



We are looking for candidates who can understand a problem, organize the data, build a practical solution, document their work, and explain how the process could be improved or automated.



*Why This Role Matters

As Spotter Labs grows, the company needs scalable processes instead of more manual work. This role will help build the systems, workflows, and automation needed to support faster reporting, better controls, cleaner data, and more efficient operations.

title: Low Voltage System Estimator and Cordinator
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and driven Lead Project Manager & Estimator to spearhead our low voltage and security systems division. In this dual-functioning role, you will be the backbone of our projects from conception to completion. You will accurately estimate costs to win competitive bids, and then transition into the leadership role to manage budgets, timelines, and field technicians to deliver high-quality installations.



If you have a sharp eye for blueprints, a deep understanding of electronic security systems, and the leadership grit to drive projects across the finish line, we want you on our team.



Key Responsibilities

1. Estimating & Pre-Construction

Bid Management: Review RFP/RFQ packages, architectural blueprints, electrical drawings, and specifications to determine the scope of work.



Cost Estimation: Take off quantities and estimate labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor costs using estimating software.



Vendor Relations: Source and negotiate pricing with manufacturers and distributors for parts (CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, structured cabling).



Proposal Creation: Prepare and present comprehensive, accurate, and competitive bid proposals to clients and general contractors.



2. Project Management & Execution

Project Lifecyle: Own the project from kickoff to closeout—managing schedules, material procurement, and resource allocation.



Financial Oversight: Monitor project budgets, track labor hours, approve expenses, and manage change orders to ensure maximum profitability.



Team Leadership: Supervise, schedule, and mentor field technicians and sub-contractors, ensuring code compliance and quality workmanship.



Client & Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for General Contractors, building owners, and IT directors, providing regular progress updates.



3. Compliance & Safety

Ensure all installations adhere to National Electrical Code (NEC), NFPA standards, and local building codes.



Enforce company safety protocols and OSHA standards on all job sites.



Qualifications & Skills

Required:

Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the low voltage, structured cabling, or electronic security industry, with at least 2 years in a combined estimating/project management role.



Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of IP CCTV systems, Access Control (e.g., Lenel, Software House, Avigilon), Intrusion Detection, and Structured Cabling (Cat6, Fiber Optics).



Blueprint Proficiency: Expert ability to read and interpret low voltage schematics, architectural plans, and electrical layouts.



Software Skills: Proficiency with project management software (e.g., Procore, Fieldwire) and estimation tools (e.g., Accubid, McCormick, Bluebeam).



Licensing: Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record (travel to job sites required).



Preferred (Big Plus):

Industry certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional) or RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer).



Manufacturer-specific certifications (e.g., Honeywell, Bosch, Milestone, Axis).



An active state low-voltage or electrical license

title: SEO Operator & Growth Partner (Start Salaried, Earn Equity)
description:
Think you're in the top 5% of SEOs? Prove it, and earn a piece of the business.



Please make sure to read this ad in its entirety.



Most SEO jobs pay you a salary to make someone else rich. This one starts as a salary and ends as a partnership, if you can actually rank.



We're building a portfolio of lead-generating digital assets (rank and rent) in the home services space, and we're funded, connected, and ready to move. Our first anchor relationship is a roofing company doing $30M+ per year, and our launch market is one where the founder has invested in real estate for years and already has deep relationships with the exact vendors who need these leads. We are not just building websites. We are building assets AND lifelong relationships with companies that want to scale and grow into new markets alongside us.



And there is a second opportunity here. We keep finding large, established businesses paying thousands per month to SEO providers with no transparency, no reporting they can understand, and no clear results. Our $30M anchor client was one of them. That means alongside the rank and rent portfolio, there is a real opening for a service-based SEO business built on transparency and measurable outcomes. The right person will help us build both. What we don't have yet is YOU: the operator who can take a market, a niche, and a budget and turn it into sites that rank, phones that ring, and leads that get paid for every month.



This is NOT a junior role. This is NOT "assist the marketing team." And this is NOT a job where you grind tasks forever. Your mission is to help build the machine. Here is how that works: the founder designs the business systems, structure, and checkpoints (that is his superpower), and YOU architect the actual SEO processes inside that structure. Together we create a documented, systemized, AI-leveraged operation where processes, VAs, and automation handle the repetitive work while you monitor, refine, and scale it. You will own execution from keyword research to ranked asset, and you will earn equity in what you build.



**The Opportunity**

You've probably ranked sites before. Maybe your own affiliate projects, maybe client sites at an agency where you did the work and someone else kept the upside. You have the skill. What you don't have is capital, deal flow, and a partner handling the business side. That's what we bring:



- Funding for site builds, content, links, and tools

- An in-house programmer and a plug-and-play build system: you will NOT be building websites. You define the strategy and structure, our team deploys the sites fast

- Established vendor relationships in our launch market from years of real estate investing, so leads have buyers from day one

- A collaborative environment: you work directly with the founder, not through layers of management

- An existing relationship with a $30M home services company, with more in the pipeline

- Business systems, checkpoints, and a partner focused on selling the leads you generate

- A real path to equity partnership for the right person



Your mission: build, rank, and scale a portfolio of local lead-generation websites in home service niches. Hit the milestones, earn your stake.



**What You'll Own**

- Market and keyword research: pick winnable niches and cities with real lead value

- Site strategy and direction: you define the architecture, keyword mapping, on-page requirements, and conversion approach. Our in-house programmer and build system handle the development. You direct, they build

- Content strategy and quality control: real content that survives Google updates, not thin templated pages

- Link building and local SEO: citations, GBP strategy where applicable, authority building

- Rank tracking, call tracking, and lead reporting: you own the numbers and report against agreed checkpoints

- Continuous adaptation: algorithm updates, AI search shifts. You stay ahead so we don't get caught flat-footed

- SYSTEMS AND SOPs: every process you run gets documented into a playbook: keyword research, site launches, content QC, link building, reporting. This is how you graduate from doing the work to running the operation, and it's a core requirement for partnership

- AI leverage: design and own the AI-assisted workflow (content briefs, keyword clustering, internal linking, QC). We fund the stack; you architect how it's used





**Qualifications & Requirements**

- PROVEN local SEO results: live sites you've ranked, with Ahrefs/Semrush data you can walk us through on a screen share (screenshots alone won't cut it)

- 3+ years hands-on SEO experience: on-page, technical, and link building

- Rank and rent, affiliate, or lead-gen experience strongly preferred. If you've built your own money sites, tell us about them

- Fluent English (written and spoken) is REQUIRED

- Strong technical SEO knowledge: site structure, schema, page speed, and tracking (call tracking, GA4). To be clear, you will not be doing web development, but you must know what good looks like and be able to spec it

- Owner mentality: you make decisions, you don't wait for instructions

- Systems thinker: you document as you go, build repeatable processes, and delegate to VAs and AI tools. Knowledge hoarders need not apply

- Hands-on with AI tools for SEO workflows (or hungry to be). We're building an AI-leveraged operation, not a manual grind

- Organized and numbers-driven: you live in dashboards, not vibes

- Honest about what's working and what isn't. We make decisions on real data

- Reliable internet and professional remote workspace





**Who We Are**

We're builders and financiers, not micromanagers. We're good at designing systems, processes, and structure, and at finding money, deals, and resources. We also know our limits: we're not the ones who should be doing the SEO. This is a genuinely collaborative environment where you work side by side with the founder to construct the machine. That's why this role exists. We set the checkpoints, you own the execution. We believe businesses should run on systems, not heroes. The goal is an operation where the playbooks are so good that the machine runs even when someone's on vacation. Build that with us, hit your numbers, and you'll have more autonomy than any agency job and more upside than any salary.



**Remote Position: Work from Anywhere**

- Full-time remote

- Tools, software, and execution budget provided (Ahrefs/Semrush, content, links, VAs)

- Must overlap at least 4 hours with Central Standard Time (GMT-6) business hours for weekly checkpoint calls





**Compensation & The Partnership Path**

- Base salary: Negotiable, based on experience and proof

- Performance bonuses tied to ranking and lead milestones

- EQUITY PARTNERSHIP: on the table for the right candidate. Prove you are capable and the right fit, and we will put real terms in writing tied to real results (sites ranked, qualified calls generated, revenue per site). This is earned, not given.





**Please note**: this is a selective, multi-layer interview process. We are looking for a long-term partner, not just a hire, and the process reflects that.



Thank you for taking the time to read this ad in full. We wrote it with real care because we expect the same level of attention from the person we partner with. To show us you actually read every word, begin your application with the phrase build the machine, then tell us in one sentence the single best local SEO result you have ever achieved. Applications that skip this step will not be read. If you're tired of ranking sites for other people's benefit and ready to build assets you own a piece of, apply now. We only want operators who are proven, self-directed, and ready to build.

title: Appointment Setter — Extremely Clear US Accent Required, High Earning Potential, Full-Time Base Plus Handsome Commission
description:
**Appointment Setter — Extremely Clear US Accent Required, High Earning Potential, Full-Time Base Plus Handsome Commissions**



We run ads for bathroom remodeling companies across the US. People click our ad, answer a few questions to get qualified, and are told someone will call them shortly. Your job is to call them fast, run the script, and get them booked on our client's calendar. These are warm leads. They already raised their hand and are expecting a call.



We need to be able to move fast on this. I need you to onboard within the next day or so.



**The schedule:**

This is a full-time role with fixed hours in EST. You will work mornings and evenings, 9am to 12pm and 4pm to 8pm, for a total of 7 hours a day. You need to be reliably available during these exact windows every day. Speed matters more than anything else in this job, so being on time and ready at the start of each shift is required.



**What you'll do during the shift:**

- Watch a Slack channel for new lead notifications as they come in.

- Call each new lead within 5 minutes of the notification. The faster you call, the more likely they are to answer and the more likely they are to book.

- Open the correct client's CRM in GoHighLevel (GHL), go to the Opportunities tab, and place the call from there.

- Follow the script provided in the CRM and in Slack.

- Book the appointment directly on the client's calendar inside GHL.



**Follow-up work, done throughout the mornings and evenings:**

Not everyone books on the first call. Throughout your shift, you will go back through the leads who have not booked yet and follow up with them again, both by calling and by texting. The goal with these follow-ups is to re-engage them and get them booked, ideally for the next available day if they could not book right away. This follow-up work is a core part of the job, not an extra task, so plan to be doing it continuously during your hours, not just handling brand new leads.



**Pay:**

You will be paid $3 an hour as a base rate for your 7-hour shift, plus $5 for every appointment you personally book. There is no cap on what you can earn from bookings. We are starting a little slower with volume, but expect this to scale quickly. Early on you might be booking somewhere around 5 appointments a day. As volume increases, we expect that number to climb well past that, potentially 40 or more bookings a day for someone who is fast, consistent, and good on the phone.



**What we need from you:**

- A clear American accent. This is non-negotiable. You will be speaking directly with US homeowners and they need to feel completely comfortable and confident in who they're talking to. If there is any noticeable accent, this is not the right role for you.

- Real experience with GoHighLevel (GHL). You should already know how to navigate a CRM, find leads, place calls from within it, and book appointments on a calendar inside the platform.

- Real experience using Slack for daily work, since this is how you will receive lead notifications and communicate with the team throughout your shift.

- Real sales or phone experience. You should be comfortable holding a conversation, handling hesitation or pushback from a lead, and moving someone toward booking without sounding scripted or robotic.

- A closer mindset. You should want to win, want to earn more, and treat every single lead like it matters, because it does, both for you and for the client.

- Speed and reliability. You call new leads within 5 minutes and follow-up leads within 1 to 2 minutes of them going cold. You show up on time for every shift.

- Good internet and a quiet place to make calls from, free of background noise, during both your morning and evening windows.



**To apply:**

Send a voice note that is 60 to 90 seconds long. This step is required. If you do not send a voice note, you will not be considered, no exceptions. This is how we hear your accent and get a sense of how you would actually sound on the phone with our leads, so take it seriously and make it count. After we review your voice note, if it's a good fit, the next step is a short 5 minute call so we can get a better sense of your ability. If that goes well, we will onboard you quickly and get you into the flow right away.

title: Remote Real Estate Bookkeeper (Part-Time)
description:
REMOTE REAL ESTATE BOOKKEEPER (PART-TIME) - US COMPANY, WORK FROM THE PHILIPPINES



Cash Now Philly | Fully Remote | Part-Time, ~20 hrs/week | Reports to the CFO



=====================================



FIRST, IS THIS YOU?



You feel a small, real satisfaction when every account reconciles to the penny and the last uncategorized transaction disappears. An empty queue is a good feeling. A clean close is a good day.



You treat other people's money like it is under a microscope, because to you it is. You would rather raise an uncomfortable question than let a number sit wrong. You do not cut corners, not even the ones nobody would ever catch.



You are experienced, you manage yourself, and you bring your own systems instead of waiting to be told every step. If that is you, keep reading. This was built for you.



=====================================



THIS IS NOT FOR EVERYONE



Please do not apply if:



- You save your work for month-end instead of staying current every day

- You go quiet when you are confused instead of asking

- You need someone checking behind you

- Close enough feels fine to you



We are not being harsh. We respect your time and ours. The right person just felt more interested, not less.



=====================================



WHO WE ARE



Cash Now Philly is the leading family-owned cash home buyer in Greater Philadelphia, in business since 2017, more than 600 homes purchased, A+ with the BBB. We run three companies, we have a CFO, a weekly bookkeeping cadence, and real systems. This is a serious operation, and your work here will be treated as serious. Your talent will not be wasted.



We want A-plus work and A-players only.



=====================================



THE BOOKS YOU WOULD OWN



You would be our only bookkeeper, owning four connected sets of books:



1. Cash Now Philly (wholesale)

2. Off Market Equity (fix and flip)

3. Coffee House Holdings (rentals)

4. Owner's personal books (connected to all three through owner draws, contributions, and transfers between the companies)



=====================================



WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU



- Ownership. You run the entire finance back office, not a slice of it. It is yours.

- Trust, not supervision. You are trusted to run it your way, not watched. Nobody chases you, because you do not need chasing.

- Mastery. Four entities and real intercompany work will make you a sharper bookkeeper than a single-company seat ever could.

- Visibility. Your accuracy is seen at the top. The CFO and the owner know your name and your numbers.

- Real support. A weekly bookkeeping meeting to ask questions directly, a dedicated accounting Slack channel, and AI tools to help you name and categorize transactions fast. You are never left guessing.

- Quiet, focused work. Heads-down, no meetings all day, no rallying a team. Your focus is the point.



=====================================



WHAT YOU WOULD DO



- Record and categorize every transaction across all four books daily, coded to the correct company and account. All G&A, all COGS, all labor and commissions, all marketing.

- Reconcile every account to zero every month across all entities, and keep intercompany and owner flows tied out across the books.

- Enter all bills and invoices and flag due dates to the CFO. You prepare and enter. You do not move money. The CFO approves and pays.

- Track accounts receivable and report weekly.

- Close all four books by the fifth business day and deliver clean P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reports for each company.

- Submit Ask My Accountant items for anything unresolved.

- Keep the books IRS-audit-proof at all times, every transaction documented and traceable.

- Bring and document your systems so the process is repeatable, and improve what exists.



=====================================



WHO YOU ARE



- Experienced bookkeeper for a US real estate company, across wholesale, fix-and-flip, and rentals

- QuickBooks Online expert, ProAdvisor certification preferred

- Confident with multi-entity books, intercompany transactions, owner draws, and depreciation

- Strong, clear written English

- Honest, precise, and self-managed, the kind of person who owns a clean set of books without being managed



=====================================



THE DETAILS



- Fully remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM US Eastern, which is 9 PM to 1 AM Philippine time. Four focused evening hours, then your day is your own. This is a night-shift role. Apply only if those hours work for you long term.

- Pay: $10 at 20 hours per week.

- Growth: This starts part-time. For the right person, as our companies grow, the hours and scope can grow too. We would rather grow with someone great than keep re-hiring.

- Reports to the CFO



=====================================



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word RECONCILED so we know you read this carefully.



Then send your resume and short answers to three questions:



1. Describe your hands-on QuickBooks Online experience with a US real estate company.

2. In three sentences, describe how you run a monthly close for multiple entities.

3. Tell us about a reconciliation or categorization error you caught before anyone else noticed, and how you found it.



Strong candidates get a short call with our CFO and a brief, practical QuickBooks exercise: a few real transaction types to categorize and a small set of records to reconcile. It mirrors the actual work. We move fast and we respect your time.

title: Long Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role: 



I'm looking for a reliable long-form video editor to turn raw footage into polished, engaging videos on a consistent basis. This is an ongoing opportunity for the right person — if you do great work and communicate honestly, there's steady, recurring work here.



What You'll Do:



Edit long-form video content from rough footage into finished, ready-to-publish videos

Cut dead space, tighten pacing, and keep the viewer engaged from start to finish

Add clean transitions, on-screen text, callouts, zooms, and basic motion graphics

Sync and balance audio, remove filler, and ensure clear, professional sound

Follow direction and incorporate revision notes efficiently



Requirements:



Camtasia experience is REQUIRED. You must be genuinely proficient in Camtasia — this is non-negotiable, and I will ask you to demonstrate it.



Proven experience editing long-form video (please share your portfolio or sample work)



Strong sense of pacing and storytelling for retention



Reliable, communicative, and able to hit agreed deadlines



Honesty is essential. Please only claim skills and experience you actually have. I verify credentials and test skills before and during work. Misrepresenting your abilities or experience is grounds for immediate termination. If you're upfront about what you can and can't do, we'll get along great. If you lie, you will be fired immediately. 





How to Apply

Please include:



A short intro about yourself and your editing experience

Confirmation of your Camtasia proficiency

Links to your portfolio or 2–3 relevant samples of long-form work you've edited

Your typical turnaround time. 



In the beginning of your Intro please use the word "YouTube" so I know you have read the entire job posting.

title: Software Engineer (Django + React Native)
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Software Engineer (Django + React Native)

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, (PH or US Hours)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)

Salary Range: Starts at USD 2,000 - 3,000/ Month

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-Monthly

Benefits: Unlimited PTO and HMO after the probationary period

Equipment: Self-Provided



Job Summary:



As a Software Engineer (Django + React Native) at Wingz, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining backend APIs and mobile application features. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performance software supporting our NEMT platform.

This role requires strong experience in Django/Django REST Framework and at least 1+ year of hands-on experience with React Native.



Key Responsibilities:



Develop and Maintain Web Applications:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs using Django REST framework

• Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following best practices and coding standards.

• Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.



Develop and Maintain Backend & Mobile Application

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs using Django and Django REST Framework.

• Build and enhance mobile application features using React Native for iOS and Android.

• Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following industry best practices.

• Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of backend services and mobile applications.



Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams:

• Work closely with front-end developers, designers, and product managers to implement new features and improve existing ones.

• Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback to ensure code quality.

• Collaborate with DevOps engineers to optimize deployment processes and infrastructure.



Database Management:

• Design and optimize database schemas.

• Write efficient queries and manage database migrations.

• Ensure data integrity and security.



Testing and Debugging:

• Write unit tests and perform debugging to ensure the reliability of applications.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a timely manner.

• Conduct regular performance testing and optimize code for better performance.



Documentation and Technical Support:

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of the codebase and technical processes.

• Provide technical support and guidance to tea
mbers and stakeholders.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to continuously improve skills and knowledge.



Requirements:



• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in web development using Django and Django REST framework.

• Proficiency in Python, Django, and Django REST framework.

• At least 1 year of hands-on experience in React Native mobile development.

• Strong understanding of front-end technologies, such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• Experience with RESTful APIs and web services.

• Familiarity with database systems (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.).

• Knowledge of version control systems, particularly Git.

• Experience with Docker and containerization is a plus.

• Understanding of cloud services (AWS, GCP, etc.) is advantageous.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.

title: Strategic Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for someone who thinks about content differently.



Your job is not to make content that gets views.



Your job is to figure out what videos should exist to generate sales, then create the strategy, scripts, and storyboards that make those videos possible.



Everything you do should be based on customer psychology, data, and testing. Not opinions.



You'll analyze what is working, identify opportunities, and continually improve our content strategy based on results.



What You'll Do



* Identify content opportunities that are likely to generate revenue.

* Determine whether we need more top, middle, or bottom of funnel content to result in sales

* Analyze customer awareness levels, angles, and market sophistication to d
 what messaging will work best.

* Build content strategies based on data instead of trends.

* Write short-form video scripts for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, YouTube Shorts, and Meta / Tiktok Ads

* Create simple storyboards/ descrive what should be happening in each frame that explain each scene of the video.

* Develop strong hooks that stop people from scrolling.

* Plan calls-to-action that naturally move viewers toward becoming customers.

* Review analytics to understand why videos succeed or fail.

* Recommend new tests based on previous results.

* Build repeatable content systems instead of chasing viral trends.

* Maintains organization and full control of tests done



You Should Understand



* Direct response marketing

* Customer awareness levels

* Market sophistication

* What good top, middle, and bottom of funnel content looks like

* Customer objections

* Desire-based marketing

* Research to find angles for marketing

* Offer positioning

* Hooks and retention

* Script writing

* Storyboarding

* Consumer psychology

* A/B testing

* Organic social media strategy

* Ads testing strategy

* Content that generates sales instead of just engagement



Success Looks Like



You don't celebrate a video because it reached 500,000 views.

You celebrate it because it generated customers.



Every recommendation should answer questions like:



* Why should we make this video?

* Who is it for?

* What stage of awareness is this person in?

* What objection does this solve?

* Where does this fit in the funnel?

* What result are we expecting?

* How will we know if it worked?



Ideal Candidate



* Thinks analytically and enjoys solving marketing problems.

* Is used to strategising and creating scripts for content

* Makes decisions using numbers and evidence.

* Has experience writing high-converting short-form video scripts.

* Understands direct response copywriting.

* Can explain why a piece of content should work before it is created.

* Is comfortable testing ideas and changing strategy when the data says to.

* Enjoys researching customer psychology and buying behavior.

* Has excellent written English.



Bonus Skills



Application



Please include:

1. Examples of content strategies and scripts you've created.

2. Three short-form videos you believe generated sales (and explain why).

3. A short explanation of the difference between top, middle, and bottom of funnel content.

4. Your favorite marketing book and why.

5. Your favorite marketer and why.

6. How you would d
 whether our next 20 videos should target awareness, consideration, or conversion.

title: STATUS ALPHA A?PLAYER CONTENT OPS & SOCIAL MEDIA VA (10/10 ENGLISH, FULL?TIME)
description:
READ THIS FIRST – DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT AN A-PLAYER



If you want an easy VA job where you “just post” and coast, this is NOT for you.



I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



The entire world is going to know this brand. Right now you have a chance to get in early and become the person who runs all our content and social media operations.



I already built a detailed Content Operating System (Google Drive structure, Content Tracker, SOPs, Loom trainings, AI flows). I shoot content and drop it into a Drive INBOX.



I need ONE person who:

- Has 10/10 written English

- Is an A-player in social media operations

- Loves structure, workflows and pressure

- And can run the whole machine so I don’t have to think about it



If you are not that person, stop reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



This is a systems + social media operations + VA role.



You will NOT be a strategist.

You will NOT be a video editor.

You will NOT be a closer.



You WILL:



1) Run the Content Operating System

- Check a Google Drive INBOX every day for new videos and assets.

- Move files into the correct folders (RAW, PROOF, Stefan Asset Bank, Projects).

- Create or update rows in a Google Sheets Content Tracker (AssetID, file path, type, status, transcript level, etc.).

- Upload videos to transcription tools.

- Paste transcripts into Google Docs.

- Fix EVERY grammar, spelling, misheard word and punctuation so they read like a native wrote them (especially for testimonials, sales videos and “hero” content).

- Use AI tools plus my prompts to generate editor briefs.

- Copy the brief into our Clip Brief template (Google Doc).

- Fill in meta info (source file links, goals, output types).

- Add simple thumbnail notes (text plus which folder to pull photos from).

- Coordinate with the editor:

  - Move status from Raw -> Briefed -> Editing -> Needs Revision -> Approved.

  - Watch drafts, write clear revision notes, and only approve final versions when they hit standard.



2) Schedule and Publish Content (No Editing)

Take finished or approved assets and schedule posts on:

- Meta Business Suite (Instagram +
 Page)

-
 Profile (manual posting)

- TikTok Scheduler

- YouTube Studio (Shorts + long-form, including thumbnails)

- LinkedIn native scheduler

- X /
 (native)



You will:

- Use provided captions and CTAs.

- Apply the correct posting times per platform.

- Double-check thumbnails, tags, descriptions and links.

- Make sure nothing breaks (wrong aspect ratio, wrong cover, wrong platform).



3) Manage Comments and Public Presence

Every day you will:

- Sweep comments across all platforms (IG, FB Page, FB Profile, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X).

- Reply to comments as me, in my tone, from my point of view.

- Escalate high-intent comments (“how do I work with you?”, “I need this”) into DMs and flag them for the setter.

- Keep threads alive without sounding like a bot.



You are the first line of public interaction. You will protect and grow the brand image.



4) Support DMs and Warm Outreach (later in the role)

Not full setting, but:

- DM new followers or commenters with simple, warm openers when instructed.

- Hand over interested leads to the setter, following scripts and rules.

- Never send anything sloppy or off-brand.



5) Track Performance (Monthly)

Once per month:

- Open platform Insights.

- Add top performing posts per platform to a Performance Log (URL, views, saves, etc.).

- Write 3–10 short bullet-point learnings (patterns) based on what actually worked.

- Use these to help us d
 what to post more of.



6) Be My Right Hand VA Over Time

Over time, you will also help with:

- Simple admin tasks (file naming, basic research, organizing docs).

- Light personal VA work tied to content and ops (not random errands).



If you crush this role, you become the person I trust to keep the entire external face of the brand clean and sharp.



7) Quality Control and Taste (Thumbnails, Titles, Posts)

- Review every thumbnail, title, and key post before it goes live.

- Compare our assets to the level of:

  - Alex Hormozi

  - Top fitness creators

  - The strongest brands you follow

- If something is good but not great, you speak up:

  - You tell me and the editor what’s off

  - You suggest a clearer, stronger option (layout, text, or frame)

  - You push for the version that looks like a top 1% brand, not “another coach”



Your job is not just to press “publish”. Your job is to protect the standard as if this was your own company.



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



1) 10/10 WRITTEN ENGLISH

- Not 8/10. Not “pretty good”.

- You can fix transcripts and captions so they read like a native English speaker wrote them.

- You see grammar, spelling and punctuation errors immediately.

- You do NOT need AI to write simple, clean English.



We will test this.



2) PROVEN SOCIAL MEDIA OPS EXPERIENCE

You have real, hands-on experience posting and scheduling across multiple platforms for a coach, creator or personal brand:

- You have used Meta Business Suite (not just posting from the IG app).

- You have used YouTube Studio to upload long-form and Shorts, set thumbnails, descriptions, tags, and schedule.

- You have posted to TikTok using the web or app scheduler.

- You understand that some settings are mobile-only and can handle them (for example, IG grid preview, YT Shorts thumbnail via app, etc.).



If you have never done this before, this role will be too much.



3) CONTENT / VA BACKGROUND

- At least 2 years as a VA, social media manager, or content ops person for coaches or creators.

- You have:

  - Organized Google Drive for content

  - Maintained content calendars or trackers

  - Coordinated with editors or designers

  - Posted on at least 3 major platforms



4) YOU LIKE SYSTEMS, PRESSURE AND HIGH STANDARDS

- You enjoy SOPs, Loom trainings, and checklists.

- You like being the one who keeps everything moving and on time.

- You can handle direct feedback and a high-pressure environment.

- The first weeks will be intense. If that scares you, this is not for you.

- You have taste for high-level content and brands:

  - You know who Alex Hormozi is.

  - You pay attention to the biggest fitness influencers and how they present their brand.

  - When you see a weak thumbnail or caption, it bothers you and you know why.

- You are not afraid to call out weak work (from an editor or even fro
) respectfully, when you see something that could and should be better.



5) TOOLS (YOU MUST BE COMFORTABLE WITH)

- Google Drive, Docs, Sheets

- Meta Business Suite

- YouTube Studio

- TikTok Scheduler

- Basic Canva (for simple thumbnail tweaks)

- Simple video tools ONLY for transcripts and checks (for example CapCut auto-captions, YouTube transcripts)



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Time: Mostly PH evenings (to overlap with US time) plus light weekend coverage (1–3 hours Sat/Sun for checks, scheduling and comments)

- Start pay: 500 USD per month

- Growth: Up to 700 USD per month as you prove A-player performance, then beyond 1k+ with bonuses if you become truly critical to the company.

- Long-term, I’m open to profit-sharing or shares for the right person who becomes a key part of the core team.



This is not a side gig. If we are a fit, I want you in this seat for years.



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You like being the operator who keeps the machine running.

- You get satisfaction from:

  - A clean Drive

  - An up-to-date tracker

  - Posts going out exactly when they should

  - Comments handled fast and well

- You want to work with a brand that is growing fast and be part of building something big.

- You want clear expectations, real responsibility, and a long-term home where your income and role grow with your performance.



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



- You want to be a creative director, strategist or video editor.

- You only want 10–20 hours per week or short-term work.

- You dislike repetitive tasks, checklists, and pressure.

- You are not extremely strong in written English.

- You get overwhelmed when multiple platforms and deadlines are active at once.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW THESE STEPS EXACTLY)



Subject line:

STATUS ALPHA A-PLAYER VA – [Your First Name]



In your message, include short, direct answers to:



1) Experience

- Briefly describe the best coach or creator you worked with and what you did for their content and social media day-to-day (max 5 sentences).



2) Written English and Transcripts

- On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English (without AI)?

- In 3–5 sentences, tell me why I can trust you to fix important transcripts (testimonials, VSLs, hero videos) so they are ready to publish without me editing.



3) Social Media Tools

List which tools you have actually used in real work for posting or scheduling:

a) Meta Business Suite

b) YouTube Studio

c) TikTok (web or app scheduler)

d) Any others (GoHighLevel, Metricool, Hootsuite, etc.)



4) Proof of Ops

- Links or screenshots from ONE coach or creator you supported (social accounts you posted to, a Drive structure screenshot with names blurred, or similar).

- Optional: a screenshot of YouTube Studio or Meta Business Suite from an account you worked on (blur anything sensitive).



5) Comment Voice Test

Reply to these 2 imaginary comments as if you were me:



1. On a reel about fasted training:

   “This sounds dangerous. Why would I train without eating?”



2. On a before/after transformation post:

   “I wish I could do this but I always fall off after 2 weeks.”



Write your replies in full as if you’re answering in the comments.



6) Transcript Test (MUST DO)

Fix the following text into clean, correct English (without AI) and paste your corrected version:



so when your test on run is low, you feel like tired all the time and you dont really want to do anything

most guys they think its just motivation problem but actually its the hormones and the self image fighting against you

if you dont change the way you see yourself, you will always go back to the same body even after diet or program is finish

thats why in status alpha we first fix the inside then the body follows automatic



Applications that do not follow these steps will be ignored.



I am looking for one person who can handle high pressure, high standards, and grow with this company long term. If that’s you, apply exactly as described.

title: Senior-Level Social Content Writer for Reddit, X, and Bluesky (Long-Term)
description:
I'm the founder of a growing consumer app brand and I need a genuinely excellent writer to run my Reddit, X (formerly
), and Bluesky presence. This is not a posting or scheduling job. This is a writing job. You will be writing as me, in my voice, in communities where inauthentic content gets detected and punished instantly. If your English is anything less than native-level fluent, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Reddit, daily: Spend about 20 minutes per day writing genuine, helpful comments in a defined list of subreddits. These comments must add real value to conversations and read like a smart, direct American founder wrote them, because that's whose voice you're channeling.

- Reddit, weekly: Write and publish 2 to 3 value-first posts per week using proven templates I'll provide (case studies, personal stories, helpful breakdowns), adapted and reposted across 8 to 10 subreddits with each community's rules checked before posting.

- X, daily: Write and publish 3 to 5 posts per day on X (formerly
), mixing founder insights, short stories, and hooks, plus thoughtful replies to relevant accounts to build engagement. Test formats and report on what gains traction.

- Bluesky, daily: Write and publish 3 short posts per day, testing formats and reporting on what gains traction.

- Weekly reporting: A short summary every Friday covering karma growth, post performance by subreddit, follower and engagement growth on X and Bluesky, and what you recommend doubling down on.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



- Senior copywriter-level written English. Flawless grammar, natural idiom, zero awkward phrasing. Your writing must be indistinguishable from a native United States English speaker.

- Proven ability to write in someone else's voice. You will study my tone from provided samples and match it exactly. Include a link to work where you've done ghostwriting, brand voice work, or persona-based writing.

- Deep familiarity with Reddit culture. You understand karma, subreddit rules, shadowbans, and why self-promotion gets accounts destroyed. You know the difference between a post that reads like a person and a post that reads like marketing.

- Judgment and restraint. You will follow a strict warm-up plan with zero product promotion in the early phase. If you can't resist plugging a product early, do not apply.

- Reliability. Daily output, no exceptions, with a consistent schedule.



SKILLS THAT WILL MOVE YOU TO THE TOP OF THE PILE



- Experience growing a Reddit account or community organically

- Experience growing an X (formerly
) account with original writing, not reposts

- Familiarity with Bluesky or early-adopter social platforms

- Background writing for a female audience in lifestyle, relationships, wellness, or beauty

- Basic analytics comfort (tracking views, upvotes, referral traffic)



WHAT I PROVIDE



- Voice and tone samples so you can study and match my writing

- Proven post templates and a defined subreddit list

- A clear warm-up plan and weekly priorities so you always know what to work on



SCHEDULE AND WORKLOAD



- Roughly 2 hours per day, about 12 hours per week total

- You choose your working hours, but daily output must be consistent

- Weekly report due every Friday by 5:00 PM United States Eastern Time



COMPENSATION



- Fixed price, 75 United States dollars per week, paid weekly on delivery of the weekly output via Wise or PayPal. No hourly billing.

- The first week is a fully paid trial at the full rate, so you take zero risk trying out.

- Long-term engagement for the right person, with room to grow into a larger content role with more responsibility and higher pay.



START DATE



Immediate. I am ready to onboard the right writer this week.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "OXBLOOD" so I know you read this entire post. Then, in 150 words or fewer, rewrite this sentence in three different tones (casual, authoritative, vulnerable): "I stopped waiting for him to text back." Include two writing samples and a link to your ghostwriting, brand voice, or persona-based writing work. Applications that skip any of these steps will not receive a reply.

title: Video Editor (Contractor)
description:
Apply Here: 



Personal Brand Video Editor (Contractor) — Alex Zinni / The Creative Mogul



About This Role



I'm Alex Zinni, founder of Alpha Key Digital and creator of The Creative Mogul. I'm building a personal brand at scale, the kind of presence Alex Hormozi and Seth Godin have, where the content itself becomes the business. I write and perform music, I build ideas in public, and I'm going all-in on YouTube and LinkedIn as the engine.



This is not a role editing content for clients. This is a role editing content for me. You'd be the person turning my raw footage, talks, and ideas into a body of work that compounds, reel after reel, video after video, until the brand is impossible to ignore.



The Role



I'm looking for a contract Video Editor to be the visual engine behind The Creative Mogul. You'll own the full output: scroll-stopping shortform for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts, and polished longform for YouTube. You work directly inside my Slack and Asana so we move fast and nothing slips. This is a craft-forward, high-ownership role for an editor who wants their work seen by a lot of people and wants to help build something from the ground up.



The goal is simple and ambitious: blow this brand up. If that excites you rather than intimidates you, keep reading.



You'd Be a Great Fit If You Were...





Someone who studies creators like Hormozi, MrBeast, and the best of YouTube, and can break down exactly why their videos work

The kind of editor who rewatches a cut ten times to fix one frame, because "good enough" bothers you

Energized by the idea of building a personal brand from small to huge, and wanting to be part of that story

Obsessed with hooks and retention, you think in terms of the first two seconds and the watch-time graph, not just clean cuts

Comfortable owning a deliverable end to end without hand-holding, from raw footage to final export

Reliable to a fault: when you say a video ships Friday, it ships Friday, and it ships clean

A clear communicator who flags problems early in Slack instead of going quiet

Genuinely excited by feedback and iteration, because we'll be testing and refining constantly

Someone who wants volume, this is a high-output brand, and you're the type who thrives on shipping a lot of great work





Key Responsibilities





Edit high-retention shortform video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) with strong hooks and pacing that holds attention to the end

Produce polished longform YouTube videos that keep viewers watching

Provide full production support: assemble edits, source and cut b-roll, add motion graphics, color grade, and finish audio

Cut talking-head, music, and idea-driven content into content that stops the scroll

Color grade and correct footage to a consistent, premium standard

Design and animate captions, titles, lower thirds, and light motion graphics

Repurpose longform content into multiple shortform clips

Sync all work through Asana, keeping status, deadlines, and deliverables current

Communicate progress, questions, and blockers in Slack in real time

Hold the visual consistency of the brand across every piece

Manage and organize footage, projects, and exports so the latest version is always findable

Turn feedback into better cuts, fast





Qualifications



Required





3+ years of professional video editing experience

Proficiency in Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve

Demonstrated ability to produce high-retention shortform and longform content

Strong color grading skills in DaVinci Resolve

A portfolio or reel showing both shortform and longform work

Reliable high-speed internet and a computer capable of 4K editing and color work

Strong written English for clear Slack and Asana communication





Preferred





Experience editing for a personal brand, creator, or thought leader (vs. only corporate/client work)

Track record of videos that performed well (views, watch time, follower growth)

Motion graphics experience (After Effects or Resolve Fusion)

Familiarity working inside Slack and Asana on a distributed team





Key Skills & Abilities





Exceptional editing eye and sense of pacing

Deep understanding of retention and hooks for social platforms

Color grading and finishing

Motion graphics and titling

Audio cleanup and mixing

Self-management and consistent, on-time delivery

Clear, proactive communication

Ability to take direction and iterate without friction





What I Offer





Monthly retainer (rate based on experience and portfolio)

Flexible schedule, remote, work your own hours as long as deadlines are met

Long-term, ongoing relationship for the right person as the brand grows

Steady, high-volume creative work with real visibility

The chance to help build a personal brand from the early days and grow with it





How to Apply



Apply through this posting and include:





A link to your portfolio or reel showing both shortform and longform work

One or two examples edited in Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve, and a note on which you used

A short note on your DaVinci Resolve color grading experience

One example of a video you edited that performed well, and why you think it worked

Your availability and monthly retainer expectation





Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.
